content.text: Venezuelan creators face significant challenges when it comes to accepting payments online. Conventional platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-which-architecture-actually-works-14|Stripe Alternatives]] and PayPal are unavailable, leaving creators without viable options. However, blockchain technology and decentralized payment systems empower you to build your own infrastructure. This guide outlines how to set up a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-4|complete]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-explained-digital-4|COREMERCH guide to digital]] commerce stack, enabling you to accept crypto payments seamlessly while retaining full control over your data and transactions.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide

content.text: What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your infrastructure, ensure you have a few essential components. You will need a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic tool such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a payment processor like NOWPayments. Each of these tools is free to use, allowing you to create a fully functional store without upfront costs. Familiarize yourself with these tools to streamline the deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your tools in place, focus on integrating your payment and delivery pipeline. Create a NOWPayments account to handle your cryptocurrency transactions. Configure your backend to automatically confirm payments and trigger product delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This setup ensures your customers receive their digital products instantly after payment confirmation, eliminating delays and enhancing customer satisfaction.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure set up, it's time to go live. Publish your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring all links work correctly. Test your payment processing by making a small purchase yourself. This will help you identify any potential issues before your customers engage. Once confirmed, you are ready to promote your store and begin accepting payments from both local and international buyers.
Blockchain payments eliminate geographical barriers for creators.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Creators in Ethiopia, Cameroon, Tanzania, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and the Philippines face a compounded challenge: not only are conventional payment platforms unavailable, but local banking infrastructure may add additional friction to receiving international transfers through alternative channels. Crypto payments remove this layer entirely. A seller in Addis Ababa and a seller in Amsterdam receive USDT transactions through the same NOWPayments infrastructure, at the same speed, with the same 0.5% fee. The blockchain has no knowledge of which country a wallet is located in. The webhook fires to both backends identically. Geographic neutrality is not a feature — it is the fundamental property of how blockchains work.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
You own your infrastructure and data without reliance on external platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
Frequently Asked Questions
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?

You can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments, including USDT, BTC, and ETH. Choose the ones that best fit your audience and transaction needs, and configure them in your payment settings.
How do I ensure my products are delivered instantly?
Set up automated delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate this with your payment processing to ensure that products are sent to customers immediately after payment confirmation.
Can I sell physical products as well?
While this guide focuses on digital products, the same infrastructure can be adapted for physical goods. You would need to integrate shipping logistics into your backend to handle orders effectively.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
When you purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30 days of support. After this period, the infrastructure is entirely yours without ongoing fees or subscriptions.
How do I market my digital products?
Utilize social media platforms, email marketing, and content marketing to promote your products. Building a community around your offerings can significantly enhance visibility and sales.
